name: PowerShell 7
startCommand: function global:uv { $u = Get-Command uv -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $u) { Write-Error 'uv is not installed'; return }; $a = @($args); if ($a.Count -gt 0 -and $a[0] -eq 'init' -and -not ($a | Where-Object { $_ -in '--package','--lib','--script','--build-backend' -or $_ -like '--build-backend=*' })) { $more = @(); if ($a -notcontains '--no-package') { $more += '--no-package' }; if ($a -notcontains '--no-readme') { $more += '--no-readme' }; if (-not ($a | Where-Object { $_ -like '--author-from*' })) { $more += '--author-from','none' }; $a = @('init') + $more + @($a | Select-Object -Skip 1) }; & $u.Source @a }

name: Windows PowerShell
startCommand: function global:uv { $u = Get-Command uv -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $u) { Write-Error 'uv is not installed'; return }; $a = @($args); if ($a.Count -gt 0 -and $a[0] -eq 'init' -and -not ($a | Where-Object { $_ -in '--package','--lib','--script','--build-backend' -or $_ -like '--build-backend=*' })) { $more = @(); if ($a -notcontains '--no-package') { $more += '--no-package' }; if ($a -notcontains '--no-readme') { $more += '--no-readme' }; if (-not ($a | Where-Object { $_ -like '--author-from*' })) { $more += '--author-from','none' }; $a = @('init') + $more + @($a | Select-Object -Skip 1) }; & $u.Source @a }

env.BASH_FUNC_uv%%: () { if [ "$1" = init ]; then local a k=1 p=1 r=1 w=1; for a in "$@"; do case "$a" in --package|--lib|--script|--build-backend|--build-backend=*) k=0;; --no-package) p=0;; --no-readme) r=0;; --author-from|--author-from=*) w=0;; esac; done; if [ $k = 1 ]; then local x=(); [ $p = 1 ] && x+=(--no-package); [ $r = 1 ] && x+=(--no-readme); [ $w = 1 ] && x+=(--author-from none); shift; set -- init "${x[@]}" "$@"; fi; fi; command uv "$@"; }
